note: An ancestor chart for D. Defranceski, worked backwards. Every box is a person a document names. A WALL is a place where this archive knows a person existed and cannot name their parents — and the reasons differ. Living people are shown by initials and surname, with no dates. Where a line continues in one of the sibling archives the wall links straight into it.
